name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for go-karting, fueled by watching local races near his hometown in Quebec. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in vehicle dynamics, and quickly found himself drawn to the high-pressure environment of professional racing. He started as a data analyst for a smaller racing team, working his way up through the ranks by consistently delivering insightful performance improvements based on meticulous data analysis. 

Now at Cadillac Racing, Jean-Pierre thrives on the challenge of optimizing vehicle performance for diverse track conditions. He is known for his ability to remain calm and methodical under pressure, meticulously evaluating every aspect of the car's setup to extract maximum performance. His pragmatic approach, combined with his deep understanding of vehicle dynamics, makes him a valuable asset to the team, particularly during critical race situations. He distinguishes himself by his ability to clearly communicate complex technical information to both drivers and other engineers.

physical.description: A man of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and calculations.
Insists on calibrating his own tire pressure gauge before each session.
Has a specific playlist of classical music he listens to while analyzing data.
